ResearchProjectDef.label: Toxifier flood light

ResearchProjectDef.label: Toxifier floor light
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recess self-powered chemical lighting into the ground, trading electrical consumption for local pollution.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Toxifier standing lamp

ResearchProjectDef.label: Toxifier sun lamp

ResearchProjectDef.label: Toxifier wall lamp
